name: Livestock mortality
about: {table} is the report table (one row per report), {table}__deaths has one row per animal that died. Approved reports only. Grid is 24 columns wide.

cards.name: Animals died
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS deaths FROM {table}__deaths d JOIN {table} r ON r.submission_id = d.submission_id WHERE r.review_state = 'approved'

cards.name: Mortality rate
cards.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM {table}__deaths d JOIN {table} r ON r.submission_id = d.submission_id WHERE r.review_state = 'approved') / nullif(sum(herd_size), 0), 1) || '%' AS mortality_rate FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved'

cards.name: Households reporting
cards.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT household_id) AS households FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved'

cards.name: Waiting for review
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS waiting FROM {table} WHERE review_state IN ('received', 'edited')

cards.name: Deaths by cause
cards.sql: SELECT d.cause, count(*) AS deaths FROM {table}__deaths d JOIN {table} r ON r.submission_id = d.submission_id WHERE r.review_state = 'approved' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Deaths by animal
cards.sql: SELECT d.species, count(*) AS deaths FROM {table}__deaths d JOIN {table} r ON r.submission_id = d.submission_id WHERE r.review_state = 'approved' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Deaths by sex and age (where recorded)
cards.sql: SELECT coalesce(d.age_class, 'not recorded') AS age_class, coalesce(d.sex, 'not recorded') AS sex, count(*) AS deaths FROM {table}__deaths d JOIN {table} r ON r.submission_id = d.submission_id WHERE r.review_state = 'approved' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cards.name: Deaths per month
cards.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', d.death_date)::date AS month, count(*) AS deaths FROM {table}__deaths d JOIN {table} r ON r.submission_id = d.submission_id WHERE r.review_state = 'approved' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Deaths by village
cards.sql: SELECT r.village, count(*) AS deaths FROM {table}__deaths d JOIN {table} r ON r.submission_id = d.submission_id WHERE r.review_state = 'approved' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Latest deaths reported
cards.sql: SELECT d.death_date, r.household_id, r.village, d.species, d.cause, d.sex, d.age_class, r.herd_size FROM {table}__deaths d JOIN {table} r ON r.submission_id = d.submission_id WHERE r.review_state = 'approved' ORDER BY d.death_date DESC LIMIT 50
